run_fast_cross_entropy_loss: run fast_cross_entropy_loss with logits, labels, and optional logit_softcapping and logit_scaling parameters
create_Fast_CrossEntropyLoss: create a Fast_CrossEntropyLoss autograd function with forward and backward passes for GPU-accelerated cross entropy
patch_loss_functions: patch_loss_functions to replace transformer cross entropy losses with the optimized Triton-based implementation
run_chunked_cross_entropy_forward: run chunked cross entropy forward for large vocabularies exceeding 65536 by dividing into blocks
run_cross_entropy_backward: run cross entropy backward to compute gradients of logits with softmax and logsumexp reduction
